title: Mitchell and Webb: "Are we the baddies?"
summary: A Mitchell and Webb sketch in which two German soldiers realize their uniforms carry skulls and wonder whether they are the baddies. It is a short comedy bit about people failing to see themselves as the villains.
why: Cited constantly as a quip when a person or organization seems to be doing something morally dubious.

quote.text: this sketch from Mitchell and Webb stayed with me for years.
